stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher paused and discussed responsibility.”?
options: They can help people notice health changes, but they can also cause worry or give false alarms.
The teacher said a song alone may not change laws, but it can give people courage and unity.
The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.
Anonymity can give people courage, but it can also reduce accountability.
